pages.text: Long solo operations cause psychological strain. This is normal. You are not going crazy. Probably.$(br2)Approved coping: talking to yourself, naming your tools, and small plush companions.
ORSA does not endorse attachment to inanimate objects. ORSA does note $(bold)23% fewer$() incident reports among personnel who carry one.
A plush penguin. Holds up well in cold environments, for obvious reasons.
Certified emotional support animal. Does not judge you. Cannot judge you. Is wool.
The closest living relative of the elephant. Somehow. ORSA Zoology Division cannot explain this either.
